messages:
leah: FYI: after yesterday's RBAC consolidation PR we had a brief spike in mutual TLS failures across na-west and eu-west around 04:22 UTC. saw a pattern: cert rewraps failing with KMS permission errors and proxies returning TLS alerts. anyone triaging?
omar: digging in. edge metrics show increased TLS alert numbers and OCSP stapling timeouts. trace points to cert-authority job failing to unwrap key material. sample error: 
```
2026-03-22T04:22:05Z ca-rotator ERROR: unwrap key failed: PermissionDenied: iam::cryptoKeyDecrypt denied for principal:serviceAccount:ca-operator@infra.svc
```
ben: that serviceaccount lost a conditional binding we had earlier that scoped decrypt to `resource.name:projects/redwood/locations/*/keyRings/edge/*`. the consolidation PR removed a binding that looked unused.
leah: did the PR run the kms-impact-check hook? I thought infra-ci had that guard.
audit-bot: infra-ci: kms-impact-check not executed for PR #2137 (skipped due to legacy yaml path).
oncall: --paging-- initiating rollback of the PR to restore previous key bindings.
omar: rolling the RBAC change back now. adding temporary read-only policy to allow decrypt for ca-operator while we validate.
infra-bot: applied temporary policy at 04:28:12Z. policy binding id=pb-9922.
ben: cert jobs requeued and rewrapping succeeded at 04:30:40Z. proxies report handshake success rate back to baseline by 04:32.
leah: good. postmortem thoughts: 1) the kms-impact-check needs to be mandatory (block merge) and must check both key IAM and group memberships, 2) add a synthetic decrypt test in a sandbox that runs as the SA pre-merge, 3) enhance audit sink for Cloud KMS IAM changes so we get an alert when bindings are removed from groups that transitively grant SA access.
audit-bot: recommended alert rule added: alert when `bindings[].role=="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter" && bindings[].members` lose >0 members in a 1h window for keyrings matching /edge/. severity=high.
ben: also propose RBAC rollout policy: whenever changes touch infra SAs that issue certs, require a 1-hour canary in one region with rollout gate `certs_ok==true`. add automatic rollback if cert provision failures > 5 in 10m.
oncall: filed playbook ticket SEC-2026-410: "RBAC -> KMS preflight + canary for cert operator" with checklist and rollback commands. https://redwood.internal/sec/SEC-2026-410
leah: assign to infra and security; include timeline & audit logs in the ticket. can someone paste the minimal rollback CLI?
omar: rollback snippet: 
```bash
gcloud projects set-iam-policy redwood policy.json && kubectl apply -f /ops/rbac/previous-binding.yaml
```
ben: for immediate mitigation we also added an observability alert: certificate issuance failures > 3 in 5m -> pages oncall + creates a temporary tag on related PRs authored in last 24h.
audit-bot: archived logs and diff for incident attached to ticket.
leah: thanks all. follow-ups: make kms-impact-check mandatory, add sandbox decrypt test, add canary gating, and tune audit sinks. will schedule a quick retro tomorrow. :lock_with_ink_pen:
